gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC has big open curves that swing outward rather than curling back in. Noto Sans TC takes over from Conthrax's wide-mouthed a and tall bodies, and a long page of it feels like following one thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu sits with a high midline and counters that stay linked to the outside, plain and unfussy. And Conthrax gives it round bowls with walls that never swell, so the heading and text feel cut from one smooth tube.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana leads with wide channels running into each counter, so its lowercase forms look big and open. Noto Sans Thaana then carries a long page easily after Conthrax, whose strokes bend like copper pipe.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai reads like glass beads, swollen lowercase with rounded letters left open. Noto Sans Thai handles the sustained reading, while Conthrax, with its flat, unvarying line, does its best work as the display heading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-thai-lo: Conthrax draws everything with zero stroke modulation, a wide-mouthed a and bodies so tall the capitals barely rise above them. And Noto Sans Thai Looped matches that tall build, its bold-looking lowercase and spacious curve terminals giving the pair real presence.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tifinag: Conthrax runs its stroke edges parallel through every curve, giving the display line a precise, machined look up top. Noto Sans Tifinagh adds rounded, inviting lowercase bowls that fill the line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Wide, sharp and drafted. Noto Sans Tirhuta cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap and stands on a dominant x-height, which sits well under the steady technical-pen line of Conthrax.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-ugariti: Tight, tall and open-mouthed. Conthrax is the one for display, with joints that meet without thinning or bulging, while Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps a small step from lowercase to capital and arcs left unjoined like chalk.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-vai: Conthrax draws with zero stroke modulation, wide and exact. Noto Sans Vai makes words look like solid blocks rather than skylines, with generous room between curve ends and stems, so a long page keeps moving.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-vithkuq: Conthrax has a drafting-pen outline quality, one constant nib width all through its wide, tall-bodied letters. Noto Sans Vithkuqi follows with open throats in a, c, e and s, and a minimal step up to capitals, so give it a modest size.
